items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: all of us, Billy Butterfield, all of us, both white and black, go down there and jam

ctx.x: That's right, that's right, and no paid admission. But to go out there and sit in and jam where people are paying to come in that door, all they giving you is just a drink and a sandwich or a steak, whatever, you know, you got money, you can buy that. So you know and so those things I wouldn't think of doing again, you know. Like a lot of times, oh used to jam downtown, Hawkins, all of us, Billy Butterfield, all of us, both white and black, go down there and jam, and in the back room they would have their little…

record that you was down there jamming and they was back there getting it off the tape, making a master of it, going over there in Europe and selling them to those different companies. There you are playing.
